package.name: undercanopy_ekf_nav
package.description:
LiDAR-IMU EKF for under-canopy row following with GNSS outage bridging. Implements crop-row detection via 2D LiDAR, EKF-based sensor fusion (GNSS + IMU + wheel odometry), and row centerline output for lane-following and path-planner return targets.
Part of the Autonomous Agricultural Tractor project — CEN 4930, FGCU Spring 2026. Author: Krish Shah
